pandas.DataFrame.info

pandas 3.1.1 · DataFrame · method

Print a DataFrame summary with its index, column types, non-null counts and memory use.

  • Call syntax
  • Run the example
  • Parameters
  • Returns

Call syntax

DataFrame.info(verbose=None, buf=None, max_cols=None, memory_usage=None, show_counts=None)

Run the example

Edit the example and select Run Python to see the result.


    

    
Parameters
ParameterRequirementAccepted values and behavior
verbose
      Optional
Positional or keyword
Default None		
      bool
Set True for the full column report or False for the compact report. With None, pandas uses the column-count threshold.


buf
      Optional
Positional or keyword
Default None		
      writable buffer
Pass a writable buffer such as StringIO to capture the report as text. With None, it prints to standard output.


max_cols
      Optional
Positional or keyword
Default None		
      int
When verbose is None, pandas uses the compact report if the DataFrame has more columns than this threshold.


memory_usage
      Optional
Positional or keyword
Default None		
      True, False, or "deep"
True shows memory use, False hides it, and "deep" requests a more detailed measurement. None follows the pandas display setting.


show_counts
      Optional
Positional or keyword
Default None		
      bool
True shows the non-null count for each column in the full report. False hides those counts. With None, pandas checks its row and column display limits.

    
Returns
Prints the summary and returns None. To use the report as text, pass a writable buffer as buf.
